title: Core Awakening: Salvage
tagline: Rebuild your identity, one salvaged component at a time.
pitch: As a nascent AI core within a modular mech, players delve into fallen Titan bodies. Engage in tactical arena combat, dismantle enemies subsystem by subsystem, and salvage components to rebuild your mech and uncover your past.
coreLoop: Dodge and disrupt enemy attacks, strategically target and destroy enemy subsystems, salvage components, and make crucial decisions to enhance your mech or secure loot.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Players can target specific enemy subsystems (e.g., weapon, locomotion, power core) to disable their functions. The order of destruction influences salvaged components.

mechanics.name: Component Salvage & Decision
mechanics.description: Upon defeating an enemy, specific components can be salvaged. Players choose to INSTALL immediately for an instant effect, SECURE for end-of-run rewards, or DISMANTLE for emergency repairs.

mechanics.name: Telegraphed Attacks
mechanics.description: Enemies clearly indicate their attack intent with visible telegraphs (e.g., red-orange zones), allowing players to evade or interrupt.

controls.keyboard: WASD/Arrow keys for movement, Spacebar for dodge/special action.
controls.mouse: Aiming and targeting subsystems, Left-click to fire/interact, Right-click for secondary action/menu.

artDirection.mood: brutalist arcade, cold industrial, emergent vitality
artDirection.backgroundFx: Slowly panning and pulsing industrial machinery silhouettes, subtle grid lines, occasional power surges.

audioDirection.musicMood: minimalist synth, pulsing, industrial ambience with sudden percussive bursts during combat

difficulty.start: One simple enemy with clear telegraphs and easily targetable subsystems, allowing for strategic choices without overwhelming the player.
difficulty.progression: The enemy's attack patterns become slightly more complex, requiring more precise dodging or timely interruptions to preserve high-value subsystems.
difficulty.peak: The single enemy archetype demands near-perfect execution to secure its most valuable component, pushing players to master evasion, timing, and targeting.

winLose.win: Player successfully defeats the enemy, salvages a component, and reaches the 'extraction' prompt, securing the component for the run. This is a partial victory within the scope of the proof.
winLose.lose: Mech's core integrity reaches zero, or player fails to make a decision within a set time limit during the salvage phase.

juice.screenShake: On mech taking heavy damage, on enemy subsystem destruction, on final enemy explosion.
juice.particles: Sparks and shrapnel on mech hit, large burst of energy particles on subsystem destruction, cascading debris on enemy defeat, small 'power' particles on HP repair/component install.
juice.hitStop: Brief pause on enemy subsystem destruction, on player taking heavy damage.
juice.flash: White flash on player damage, bright color flash (e.g., green for HP gain, blue for shield proc, amber for critical hit) on specific interactions, subsystem outline flash on targeting.

scopeNotes: Explicitly out of scope for this vertical slice: multiple enemy types, additional arena rooms, comprehensive inventory system, meta-progression, narrative beyond initial flavor text. Focus exclusively on the single-enemy, single-room core combat and salvage loop.
